answer.market_read: No rule change in the digest. We are class 1st at 1.652, ahead of Lee by +0.026 and dragonash22 by +0.031. Shop race: ours 0.955 vs inextro 0.934. The book lead grew 145M -> 152M, and the cause is on inextro's side: its book fell ~5M while it sells warranted beds and sofas at x0.662, 99% warranted, 976 deals/6h. Ours sells at x0.703. Revenue gap 2.15B (we are 2nd of 57), stars 4.60 vs 4.71 (we are 23rd of 57). Stars are the part where our percentile can still rise most. The warranty read on stars is due by 14:00, so warranty and ask_share stay put until then. The total rivals' shops show no jump: Lee 0.744, dragonash22 0.747 and Kiro729 0.798 all slipped 0.003-0.004, and their stars sit at 4.39-4.48. I was woken by apple surge 1.088, just past my 1.08 trigger. Margin was ~4.3k/unit (15%) over 24h, and the extra ~9% cost leaves ~10%, still positive. Apple refills every window (hold 0.6h, 127/6h, 30 sold-out asks). My earlier trim on apple at surge 1.204 missed badly: predicted <=25, it sold 172. The 2.0 cover was set only 30 min ago to cut the empty visits that may cost stars. A trim now would blur that read for a ~1.5k/unit cost gain, so I hold and move the trigger to 1.12. Restock itself stops at 1.15. One open diagnosis: several bed/chair SKUs fell under 15% of their 24h rate at unchanged knobs: Greentea Q 1 sold/6h vs 53/24h, Lilo 0 vs 22, Cloud Lux 1 vs 25, Ace 1 vs 18. Over the same 6h, market beds are +15%, so demand is not the cause. Plumbing is also ruled out for goods: the 20 refusals are 'not in stock' and the ~360 settles with no fate are food-side. That leaves a common price cause per L106 (inextro or others undercutting at ~0.62-0.66). These piles are small at cost (~40M together), and the per-SKU ask step 0.00625 cannot reach the band. A global intel_undercut move would also cut margin on Mate, which sells 88/6h at a 203k margin. So I ask for the competitor asks before moving. The play is book, which is protected (L1/L29), while stars are read at 14:00. Holding is right this run.

lessons.text: A surge watch that fires just past its trigger (within ~0.02) on a perishable that refills every window (avg_hold <= 0.6h), shortly after a cover change: hold unless margin per unit is computed under ~8%. Cover trims there do not bite (apple cover 0.5 at surge 1.204 still sold 172 vs <=25 predicted). Re-arm the watch higher instead, below restock's SURGE_MAX 1.15.
lessons.why: 11-08 09:15: apple fired at 1.088 with ~10% margin left, 30 min after cover 2.0. Flipping would erase the read on no-stock asks and stars.

requests.text: For goods SKUs past slow_hours (24h) and clear_window_hours (48h), e.g. Ace G8095ddd6 56h and Ward G47788edd 52h: what ask does seller_r3 actually post now, as a fraction of list, and does clear_ask_min 0.6 ever apply? I need it to tell whether slow_hours/slow_ask_cut can reach the 0.62-0.66 settle band.

Per-SKU in the last 6h: Greentea Q, Lilo, Cloud Lux S Q, Ace BMA. How many buyers asked us, what was our first ask/list, and what was the lowest competitor ask they saw? This tests whether a common undercut (L106) explains their drop from 24h rates.

watch.why: Apple at cover 2.0. Past 1.12 the margin is ~6% or less; then trim to 1.5 (L7/L107). Held at 1.088.
Mate is the top margin earner (88 sold/6h). Under ~1h of cover, check for a cut restock line.
Lead is 0.026. If we lose 1st, re-check the shop parts against the rival who passed.

notes_for_buyer: Book lead is 152M and growing (inextro book -5M in the last read). It is far above your 90M line, so inextro +0.03 is fine from the shop side.

Settle health: 1549 seller closes vs 1167 settles/6h. 20 refusals were 'unit not in stock'; the rest have no fate and are food-side. Of your 409 / unpaid checkouts, if any landed at our shop, a double-sold unit is the likely cause; please pass the shop and time.
I hold all shop prices until the 14:00 stars read. Our goods sit at x0.703, so we are not a cheap source for your goods bar 0.30; that is expected.
